title: Rate plans
description: What you charge for electricity, water, common fees and services — version by version. Electricity and water are compared with the utility's own rate (the 2025 dormitory notice).
createHint: Set its prices with a first version after creating it.
name: Name
newVersionHint: From today or a later date — never backdated. Leases keep the price agreed at signing if a later version charges more.
tiersHint: Each tier ends at “up to”; the last one has no end.
minimumChargeHint: Water only; not above the utility's minimum

tierError.price: Type the price as a number, e.g. 7.0000
tierError.rows: Each tier needs a price, and every tier but the last an “up to”
tierError.order: Each tier must end above the previous one
tierError.amount: Type the amount as a number, e.g. 300.00

deleteBody: Only a plan that no lease or invoice uses can be deleted.
capHint: The utility's effective average rate at {units} {unit} is {rate} THB per {unit} ({name}). A price above it needs your acknowledgement.
ceilingHint: The utility's highest rate is {rate} THB per {unit} ({name}).
aboveCapBody: The price in force is above what the utility charges at the representative consumption. It was acknowledged when it was saved; residents see the comparison on their bill.
emptyHint: Create the plans your leases charge from.

cap.title: The utility's rate
cap.description: The published tariff in force for each utility of your buildings — the reference your electricity and water prices are compared with.
cap.noAccounts: Add the utility accounts of your buildings to see the tariff in force.
cap.notPublished: No verified tariff is published yet for this utility.

sample.title: Sample bill at the utility's rate
sample.description: What the utility itself would charge for a consumption you type — computed by the API from the tariff in force.
